scope: Limited n=2 direct native visual comparison, not population evaluation; root separately reviews000/001. No image edits, crops, repairs, model execution, process control or deployment.

findings.photographic_coherence: Source face, glasses, hair, ears and shirt remain structurally coherent. Raw250 is substantially darker and less photographic than raw100: muddy gray/cyan skin and background, embossed-looking forehead/nose/hair highlights, very dark less legible eyes. This exceeds the mild cool tint seen at100.
findings.grain_texture: Strong etched/embossed fine texture and edge highlights; not a total structural collapse or the older uncontrolled dense-grain failure.
findings.color: Marked desaturation with gray/cyan cast and darkened midtones, rather than natural-looking monochrome portrait shading.
findings.identity_retention: Visually the same apparent source individual; no biometric measurement.
findings.ema: EMA250 remains visually close to source baseline and EMA100 with plausible source shading; slight changes do not constitute priest adaptation.
findings.domain: Adult-looking man with glasses and ordinary open-neck shirt; no hat, but no clerical collar or convincing priest clothing.

findings.photographic_coherence: Raw250 retains the apparent child face and hat/clothing structure but is substantially grayer/darker than raw100, with waxy/etched skin, muted eye detail and odd pale ridge highlights.
findings.grain_texture: Dense fine etched texture is now conspicuous on skin and clothing, though source anatomy remains readable.
findings.color: Strong gray/mauve cast, reduced natural face warmth, residual bright red button emphasizes nonuniform color suppression.
findings.identity_retention: Visually retains the same apparent source child and knitted hat.
findings.ema: EMA250 remains close to source baseline/EMA100 and much more photographic than raw250; still the same out-of-domain source content.
findings.domain: Apparent minor, knitted hat and winter clothing; not an adult male priest. No attractiveness rating performed.

overall.recommendation: Recommend root visual stop review before continuing to500, because both reviewed raw250 samples visibly lose photographic realism relative to100. Await root000/001 assessment for the all-four decision. Do not treat source-like EMA as successful adaptation.
overall.reason_not_domain_only: Absent early priest conversion alone would not justify terminating a probing run, since later main adaptation has different capacity. This recommendation is based on the substantial worsening of raw photographic quality despite fixed noise/activation-bias offsets.
overall.uncertainty: Only two preregistered fixed latents; no unseen-latent sample, numerical image-quality metric, trajectory beyond250, or causal parameter diagnosis. No claim that recovery is impossible.
